record.question: Who is the new Defence Minister of India?
record.explanation: Answer A: Rajnath Singh. Rajnath Singh took charge as Defence Minister on June 1, 2019, before this June 2019 exam. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1573089&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
